pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   D. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   B. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   D. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures able to: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. D — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Names of Scriptures able to:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Eid; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
